On 12/17/13, 5:59 PM, Michael Betancourt wrote:

> Soï¿½.I don't see any problem using the model and data Bob passed
> along and the current development branch:

I just verified that Jason's model and data
IS a problem in the 2.0.1 release (see below).

The good news is that we plan to finish CmdStan 2.1.0 as soon
as tomorrow. Then we need to let the R and Python interfaces
catch up, but the official 2.1.0 release across interfaces
should be very soon.

- Bob

P.S. Here's the results I got.

$ ./space_model diagnose data file=space_model.data.R init=0
Rejecting inititialization at zero because of divergent gradient.

With random inits, the gradients look OK.

But when trying to run the model with random inits, I get this
every time:
